🌟 m3e-canvas | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Rapid prototyping and design of Material 3 Expressive mobile and desktop UIs, with the ability to generate prompts for AI-powered code generation.
✨ Key Features: • Drag-and-drop Material 3 Expressive UI components • Magnetic connections for grouping elements • Real Material 3 Expressive loading indicators • Support for phone and desktop screen sizes with responsive layout adjustments
📖 Summary: M3E Canvas is a browser-based design tool that allows users to visually sketch and prototype Material 3 Expressive UI screens. It enables linking screens, simulating tap-through navigation, and generating AI-friendly prompts for code generation.
